    abbrev ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.AnalyticClosure.Fibonacci.FibonacciOSInfiniteHilbertSpace :
    Type

    The infinite-dimensional Hilbert space carrier.

    H := ℓ²(ℕ, ℂ), Mathlib's canonical separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert space. Carries:

    • NormedAddCommGroup — lp.normedAddCommGroup;
    • InnerProductSpace ℂ — lp.instInnerProductSpace;
    • CompleteSpace — lp.completeSpace.

      noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.AnalyticClosure.Fibonacci.fibOSInfBasis (n : ℕ) :
      FibonacciOSInfiniteHilbertSpace

      Canonical orthonormal basis vector at index n. This is lp.single 2 n (1 : ℂ) — the ℓ² vector with 1 at position n and 0 elsewhere.

      Equations
      • ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.AnalyticClosure.Fibonacci.fibOSInfBasis n = lp.single 2 n 1

        theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.AnalyticClosure.Fibonacci.fibOSInfBasis_inner (i j : ℕ) :
        inner ℂ (fibOSInfBasis i) (fibOSInfBasis j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

        Inner product of two basis vectors: pairwise orthonormal.

        ⟨e_i, e_j⟩ = δ_{ij} on ℓ²(ℕ, ℂ).

        noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.AnalyticClosure.Fibonacci.fibModeProj (k : ℕ) :
        FibonacciOSInfiniteHilbertSpace →L[ℂ] FibonacciOSInfiniteHilbertSpace

        Rank-1 orthogonal projection onto the k-th occupation mode. P_k = |e_k⟩⟨e_k|, built as toSpanSingleton ∘ innerSL.

          noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.AnalyticClosure.Fibonacci.fibNumberOpTrunc (M : ℕ) :
          FibonacciOSInfiniteHilbertSpace →L[ℂ] FibonacciOSInfiniteHilbertSpace

          Truncated number operator N_M := ∑_{k=0}^{M} k · P_k. A finite sum of scaled rank-1 projections — manifestly a bounded CLM and self-adjoint.
